text: Fixed. Over the hero photo the current page's pill ("Home") was white text on a near-white pill. It is now a white-glass pill with white text, and the usual sage pill once the header turns solid. Verified live on staging.

Replaced. The hero is now the practice's own photo of a toddler at the gumball machine by the front desk (the front of house shared with the family practice), framed on the child. The old close-up of Dr. Nguyen moved to card 3 of the first-visit path, at a size it holds. Verified live on staging.
Changed. The intro now opens: "Dr. Tam Nguyen is a board certified pediatric dentist, committed to providing you with excellent dentistry in a comfortable environment." Verified live on staging.

Question, nothing changed yet. The kids site uses slate #505860 and sage #A3B5AA taken from the Mason Park Dental for Kids logo, plus a sun yellow #F6C04B and a sky blue added for a children's practice; the fonts are Fraunces (headings) and Nunito (body). We do not have the brand guide from the Drive. The only practice palette we have on file is the family practice's Figma handoff (copper #8C6349, beige, slate #2E3538; Newsreader, Nunito Sans, Karla), which is different. Could you attach the brand guide here, or confirm which colours and fonts the kids site should use? We will apply it site-wide once confirmed.
Fixed. The photo's scroll parallax was sliding it over its own caption. The parallax is off on that photo and the caption has room, so it reads in full. Verified live on staging.

Replaced with a credibility line: "Board certified in pediatric dentistry, and trained at Boston University to treat children from six months old." Both facts are from Dr. Nguyen's published bio. Verified live on staging.

Added to the 6-to-9-years stage: "silver diamine fluoride (SDF) to stop an early cavity from growing without drilling". SDF was not mentioned on the old site, so please flag it if the wording needs the practice's own description. Verified live on staging.
Added: Invisalign® in this sentence and on the Invisalign® tag below it. The menu item "Invisalign" (on every page) is unchanged; say if you want the mark there too. Verified live on staging.
Changed to: "When they turn eighteen, Mason Park Dental of Katy is just down the hall." Verified live on staging.

Fixed on the homepage: the card now reads "Nitrous oxide, oral conscious sedation, IV sedation, and general anesthesia." with no hospital setting (verified live on staging). Leaving this open for one question: the old site said general anesthesia is done "in a hospital setting at HCA West Houston", and that line still appears on the sedation, restorative, extractions, crowns, comprehensive care, services, about, doctors and refer-a-patient pages. Should it come off those as well?
Caption changed to: "The Cavity Free Club, by the front desk: there to reinforce healthy, everyday brushing habits." Verified live on staging.
Heading changed to: "Meet the dentist your child will grow up with." Verified live on staging.
Changed to "Board certified pediatric dentist". Verified live on staging.
Replaced "Also here: Dr. Dave Cho" with "Hometown: Houston, born and raised in the southwest of the city", from her bio. The three facts are now all about Dr. Nguyen. Verified live on staging.
Replaced the team line-up with a pediatric photo: a boy at the Cavity Free Club shelf by the front desk. The team photo is still on Meet the team, one click away. Verified live on staging.
Rewritten: "Our front desk, assistants and hygienists: friendly faces your child gets to know, visit after visit." Verified live on staging.
Fixed. The path photos opened in greyscale and only coloured in as each card reached the middle, so most people saw them grey. They are in full colour from the start. Verified live on staging.
In colour, and a different photo: Dr. Nguyen with a smiling child in the chair (it fits "Your lap, or the chair"). The knee-to-knee exam now appears once on the page. Verified live on staging.
Linked: "Call (281) 578-7100" dials, "book online" opens the booking page, and "patient forms" goes to the New Patients page where the forms are. Verified live on staging.

Rewritten: "Infants and anxious toddlers are examined knee to knee, on a parent's lap. Older children climb up into the big chair, with the screen on the wall to watch and a step-by-step explanation before anything happens." Verified live on staging.
Changed to "...so you and your child see what we see." Verified live on staging.

Yes: this paragraph was on the practice's old New Patients page, word for word, so it is theirs. Highlighted: card 6 is now a solid sage card titled "Every new patient visit gives back.", with a link to the Pay It Forward program on the New Patients page. Verified live on staging.

Surfaced. The hero now carries a "New patient special: $129 exam, X-rays and cleaning, ages 12 and under" pill under the intro, linking to Special offers. The card at the end of the path stays where the decision lands. Verified live on staging.
Heading changed to "What parents have to say." Verified live on staging.

Faster. The review now finishes writing when its middle reaches the middle of the screen, while the photo is still beside it (before, it only finished as it left). The same timing now applies to every written statement on the site. Verified live on staging.

Changed. The reviews now rotate on their own, slowly, and stop while the cursor (or keyboard focus) is on them. Scrolling no longer moves them. On phones they stay a swipeable row. Verified live on staging.

We could not find the updated image. Nothing new is in the Instatic media library since Sep 9, the frame in the Google Photos album is unchanged, and nothing is attached to this task. Could you attach it here? Also, per #2 this gumball photo is now the homepage hero, and the front desk photo took its place in this section so the scene appears once. Your edited version (black slacks) will replace it in the hero as soon as we have it.
